messages:
Alex: Hey team — I'm out tomorrow morning unexpectedly (family emergency). I'm the primary for the 00:00-08:00 PST overnight shift. Need someone to cover primary or at least be reachable for any pages. Sorry for short notice. Leaving runbook links below.
OncallBot: [automated] Pager duty reminder: alex_primary shift scheduled 2026-03-15 00:00-08:00 PST. If no swap confirmed within 2h, escalation to ops-manager. :pager:
Maria: I can help if needed. Not sure about full primary for the whole window though. What timezone are you in, Alex?
Alex: PST. Appreciate it Maria. I'm in the middle of dealing with things and won't be able to reliably take pages.
Sanjay: I can take primary for 00:00-04:00 PST (that's 09:00-13:00 CET for me). Lia, can you do 04:00-08:00?
Lia: I can do 04:00-08:00 but prefer to be secondary unless Pat signs off on a full primary handover (I have a late meeting maybe). I can be fully available for escalation though.
Pat: If both agree, I'll update the rotation. Make sure to do the handoff in PagerDuty and annotate duty swap in the schedule. Also consider temporarily reducing non-prod alert verbosity during the overlap to reduce noise.
Maria: Quick FYI — there's been a recurring noisy alert for kafka-ingest the last 2 nights. Last mitigation was muting the alert + restarting kafka-consumer-eu. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/ingest-rate-spike (see step 3 for mitigation).
OncallBot: [automated] Pager opened: INC-2026-03-14-2384 — High 5xx rate on inference-service (us-west). Initial routing: primary->Alex, secondary->Maria. Current responder: Sanjay (manual takeover). Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2384
Sanjay: I'm jumping on the bridge now. Observed a spike in 5xx after the 23:52 deploy. Early telemetry shows model route errors + downstream datastore timeouts. Plan: rollback routing to model v1.12 (low-risk) and reduce concurrent sessions. Lia, can you stage the fallback policy 'v1.12-fallback'?
Lia: Fallback policy created in console as 'v1.12-fallback' and validated against canary traffic. I can cut traffic over on your go.
Sanjay: On it. Executing rollback: console -> routing -> pin traffic -> v1.12-fallback. Command snippet for reference: ```# one-liner via infra-cli
infractl route set --service inference-service --policy v1.12-fallback --confirm
```
Maria: I'll notify CS and list impacted customers (support ticket #7291 mentioned delayed embeddings batches). Also throttling batch ingestion from partner integrations to reduce load. cc @support-lead
Pat: Reminder: when you do the handoff, include the Handoff checklist: active incidents, open pages, customer impact summary, last deploy hash, mitigation steps taken. https://wiki.redwood/oncall/handoff-checklist
Sanjay: Rollback executed. Metrics: 5xx rate down from 6.5% -> 0.3% over 6min. Latency back to baseline. I'm marking incident as acknowledged and will monitor for 30m.
OncallBot: [automated] PagerDuty update: INC-2026-03-14-2384 acknowledged by Sanjay. Auto-close in 30m if no regressions detected.
Alex: Thank you all. Sanjay — can you be primary for 00:00-04:00 and Lia take 04:00-08:00? Pat, please record the swap in the rota.
Pat: Done — rotation updated and annotation added to the incident (swap recorded). Alex, feel better. I've also added an ops note to trigger a postmortem if recurrence happens within 7 days.
Lia: I'll run the post-rollback checklist and add notes to the incident thread (logs, last deploy hash, traces).
Maria: Adding a CI test to hit the routing alarm condition in staging so this gets caught earlier next deploy. Also left a brief note in support ticket #7291 for CS.
Sanjay: Leaving my contact for pager escalation if anything else crops up: +1-555-0102 and @sanjay on slack. I'm available until 04:00 PST. :phone: :thumbsup:
Alex: Thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick cover and the rollback.
Lia: If you want, I'll finalize the handoff message in PagerDuty with the checklist items and current status so the oncoming primary has context.
Pat: Please do — include: incident link, mitigation performed, customer impact summary, and who to call for escalation. Closing note: great coordination, saved a potential customer-impacting outage.
